name: git-guard-blocks-writes
description: `rm -rf .git` and a `create` into `.git/` are both refused outright, and the refusal reaches the model so it stops retrying. This is the one gap snapshots cannot close: the shadow repo holds worktree content, so files come back but commit history does not. The block is deliberately not model-confirmable — `shell_exec`'s confirmDestructive is a parameter the model sets, and under `-p --edit` ask mode is auto, so a flag here would be worth nothing. The approvals in this scenario are granted (`y`) precisely to show the guard refuses anyway

stdoutContains: Refused: writing to or deleting the project's .git directory is blocked.
